grow.title: Cora man walna tawi
grow.body: Man Û, man ulna balna bara man sturka balna ba man aihwa lani piaya ra aiwananka daukisa.

privacy.title: Man sturka wan yamni dukia
privacy.body: Dukia apu upla piaya ra sula. Man alkisna dia sut Cora IA ra sula waia, bara pas ba utwan baku sa.

mascot.title: Man pitahayam kaikwa
mascot.body: Naha pitahaya ba man aihwa lani walna tawi, panika apu, castigo apu — nibel baman pura briwa.

lifeStage.title: ¿Naiwa nan piaya ra man?
lifeStage.subtitle: Naha ra Cora ba man dukiara aiwananka daukisa. Man yawa lani wina taim balna lakwaia sip man.
lifeStage.saveError: Man piaya ba yamwa sip apia kan. Kli talwa.

avatar.title: Man avatar ba wali
avatar.subtitle: Nicaragua tasba wina animal balna — as ta lak alki kaikaia dukiara.
avatar.loadError: Avatar balna kaikaia sip apia kan.
avatar.emptyDescription: Piaya wina as wali man sip, man yawa lani wina.
avatar.saveError: Man avatar ba yamwa sip apia kan. Kli talwa.

medicalBackground.title: Mahka siknis balna
medicalBackground.subtitle: Naha ra man walna tawi sip yang. Opcional sa — piaya wina bapikma, man yawa lani wina.
medicalBackground.familyHistoryPlaceholder: Ulw. diabetes, tala pura kaia man kumi lani ra...
medicalBackground.saveError: Man mahka siknis balna yamwa sip apia kan. Kli talwa.

mascotIntro.title: Man pitahayam kaikwa
mascotIntro.body: Aihwa lani bani ulna walna tawi — panika apu, castigo apu. Nibel wina walna sin wilras.

consent.title: Wan sturka bara Cora IA
consent.aiShareLabel: Cora IA walna sturka wali sula
consent.aiShareDescription: Pas ba utwan baku sa. Man alki lakisna, Cora ba man ulna wina alki kaikaia sip sa — permiso apu apia baku apia.
consent.disclaimer: Cora siknis marikras, dakta walna aisi kaikaia wina apia sa.
consent.saveError: Man alki lani balna yamwa sip apia kan. Kli talwa.
